desc: Parse the input to extract N, M, A, B, and the list of bad intervals.
Construct a sorted list of bad intervals.
Iterate through each bad interval $[L, R]$.
Check if the current reachable interval $[s, e]$ overlaps with the window $[L-B, L-1]$.
If overlap exists, update reachable interval to $[R+1, \min(N, \max(\text{overlap}) + B)]$.
If the reachable interval becomes invalid (start > end), output "No".
After processing all bad intervals, check if $N$ is within the final reachable interval.
Finalize the solution and ensure it handles all constraints ($N \le 10^{12}$, $M \le 2 \times 10^4$, $B \le 20$).
